text.triple_swapping.title: Triple Swapping Configuration (1.21.11)
tooltip.triple_swapping.enabled: Master toggle for 1.21.11 triple swapping mechanics.
tooltip.triple_swapping.trigger_mode:
Choose when triple swapping is triggered:
• Only When Target > 3 Blocks: Seamless mode; only swaps if target is out of normal range (3.0–4.5 blocks)
• On Attack: Always executes triple swap on attack
• Dedicated Keybind: Swaps on pressing the execute key (default: R)
• Hold Trigger Key: Swaps continuously when attacking/holding the trigger key
tooltip.triple_swapping.slot_mode:
Choose how weapons are located on your hotbar:
• Fixed Hotbar Slot: Uses explicit hotbar slots (1–9)
• Auto-Detect Item in Hotbar: Automatically finds matching 1.21.11 weapons (prioritizing highest tier)
tooltip.triple_swapping.start_slot: Hotbar slot (1–9) for the start item (e.g. Netherite/Diamond Sword). Provides start-of-tick attributes like attack damage & attack speed.
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_slot: Hotbar slot (1–9) for the reach weapon (1.21.11 Spear). Provides 4.5-block extended reach and +0.125 hitbox margin.
tooltip.triple_swapping.attack_slot: Hotbar slot (1–9) for the finishing weapon (e.g. Mace / Axe). Applies smash bonus damage, Breach/Density/Wind Burst enchantments, or shield stun.
tooltip.triple_swapping.start_item_id: Item ID or keyword for the start attribute weapon (e.g., 'sword' or 'minecraft:netherite_sword').
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_item_id: Item ID or keyword for the 1.21.11 reach weapon (e.g., 'spear' or 'minecraft:netherite_spear'). Automatically checks AttackRangeComponent.
tooltip.triple_swapping.attack_item_id: Item ID or keyword for the finishing impact weapon (e.g., 'minecraft:mace' or 'axe').
tooltip.triple_swapping.use_attack_range: Reads the 1.21.11 minecraft:attack_range component directly from the reach item stack (e.g., 4.5m survival / 6.5m creative & 0.125 hitbox margin on Spears), using Custom Reach Distance when higher or no component is present.
tooltip.triple_swapping.reach_distance: Target acquisition distance in blocks during extended reach raycasting (default: 4.5 blocks, matching 1.21.11 Spears).
tooltip.triple_swapping.hitbox_margin: Extra bounding box expansion in blocks during raycasting (default: 0.125 blocks, matching 1.21.11 Spear hitbox_margin).
text.triple_swapping.auto_swap_back: Auto Swap Back to Start Slot
tooltip.triple_swapping.auto_swap_back: Automatically returns selection back to Step 1 (Start Slot) after attacking so start-of-tick Sword attributes stay active for consecutive hits.
tooltip.triple_swapping.swap_back_delay: Ticks to wait before switching back to Start Slot (0 = immediate same-tick ghost return, 1 = next-tick authentic hotkey timing).
tooltip.triple_swapping.client_delay: Minimum cooldown window in milliseconds between automated triple swap sequences (default: 50ms = 1 game tick).
tooltip.triple_swapping.hud_indicator: Displays a modern status pill card and dynamic target reach HUD showing live weapon icons, slot chain, and range bracket.
